title: schorm Quiz
description: A schorm quiz file (YAML, stored as quizzes/<quiz-id>.yml or quizzes/<module-id>/<quiz-id>.yml). All property names are snake_case. Rules the schema cannot express, which generated quizzes MUST still follow: (1) question ids must be unique within the quiz; (2) option ids must be unique within a question; (3) answer references ('correct', 'correct_pairs') must point at ids that exist in the same question; (4) all ids and titles must contain at least one non-whitespace character.

id.description: Unique quiz identifier. Used as the SCO id and output filename (<id>.html). Must be non-empty after trimming; prefer lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores.

module.description: Id of the module this quiz belongs to. Must match a module id declared in course.yml, and the quiz id must be listed in that module's 'items' array.

title.description: Human-readable quiz title, shown in the LMS and on the quiz page.

passing_score.description: Score required to pass, on a 0-1 scale (e.g. 0.7 = 70%). Defaults to 0.8 when omitted. Reported to the LMS as SCORM 2004 success_status and used for quiz-gated sequencing.

questions.description: The quiz questions, in display order. Each question's 'id' must be unique within this quiz.

id.description: Question identifier, unique within the quiz. Reported to the LMS as the SCORM interaction id.

type.description: Question type discriminator: one of single-choice, multiple-response, true-false, fill-blank, matching.

prompt.description: The question text shown to the learner. Markdown-capable.

points.description: Points this question contributes to the quiz score. Defaults to 1.

tags.description: Free-form tags for organizing questions. Not shown to learners.

globalFeedback.description: Feedback shown after submission, depending on whether the learner answered correctly.

correct.description: Shown when the answer is correct.

incorrect.description: Shown when the answer is incorrect.

id.description: Option identifier, unique within the question (e.g. 'a', 'b', 'c'). Referenced by the question's 'correct' field.

text.description: Option text shown to the learner. Markdown-capable.

feedback.description: Optional feedback specific to selecting this option.

scoringConfig.description: Declarative scoring configuration. NOTE: the current (v0.3) runtime ignores this block - multiple-response and matching questions are always scored all-or-nothing, and only fill-blank questions award partial credit (per correct blank). Do not rely on 'partial' semantics until a future release implements them.

mode.description: Intended scoring mode. Currently only 'all-or-nothing' behavior is implemented for choice and matching questions.

partial.description: Parameters for partial-credit scoring. Currently not implemented by the runtime.

singleChoiceQuestion.description: Multiple-choice question with exactly one correct option, rendered as radio buttons.

options.description: At least two options. Option ids must be unique within the question.

correct.description: The id of the correct option. MUST match the 'id' of exactly one entry in 'options'.

shuffle_options.description: When true, options are displayed in random order.

multipleResponseQuestion.description: Select-all-that-apply question, rendered as checkboxes. Scored all-or-nothing: the learner must select exactly the correct set.

options.description: At least two options. Option ids must be unique within the question.

correct.description: Ids of all correct options. Every entry MUST match the 'id' of an entry in 'options'.

shuffle_options.description: When true, options are displayed in random order.

trueFalseQuestion.description: True/False question, rendered as two radio buttons.

correct.description: Whether the statement in 'prompt' is true.

fillBlankQuestion.description: Fill-in-the-blank question. The 'text' contains [[blank_id]] markers that are replaced with input fields; each marker needs a matching entry in 'blanks'. Awards partial credit per correct blank.

text.description: The sentence containing [[blank_id]] markers, e.g. "The capital of France is [[capital]]." Every marker MUST have a matching entry in 'blanks', and every entry in 'blanks' MUST appear as a marker here.

blanks.description: One entry per [[marker]] in 'text'. Blank ids must be unique within the question.

id.description: Blank identifier matching a [[marker]] in the question's 'text'. MUST consist only of letters, digits and underscores (hyphens are NOT recognized inside [[...]] markers).

correct_answers.description: All accepted answers for this blank. A learner response matching any entry is correct.

case_sensitive.description: When true, answers must match the case of a correct answer exactly.

trim_whitespace.description: When true, leading/trailing whitespace in the learner's answer is ignored.

matchingQuestion.description: Matching question: each premise is paired with a response via dropdown selects. Scored all-or-nothing.

premises.description: The left-hand items to be matched. Premise ids must be unique within the question.

responses.description: The right-hand items to choose from. Response ids must be unique within the question. May contain more entries than 'premises' (distractors).

correct_pairs.description: The correct premise-to-response mapping. Every 'premise' MUST match an id in 'premises' and every 'response' an id in 'responses'.
